summary: The playbook backs up configs with eos_config/vyos_config backup: yes, registers backup_path, creates /tmp/backups/<host>, and copies the backup files there.
questions: How do I back up switch configs with Ansible?
Where can I find the path of a config backup?
How do I copy network backups to a custom folder?

answer_card.title: Back up network configs
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: Backup switch (eos)
  arista.eos.eos_config:
    backup: yes
  register: backup_eos_location
  when: ansible_network_os == 'arista.eos.eos'

- file:
    path: "/tmp/backups/{{ inventory_hostname }}"
    state: directory

- copy:
    src: "{{ backup_eos_location.backup_path }}"
    dest: "/tmp/backups/{{ inventory_hostname }}/{{ inventory_hostname }}.bck"
  when: ansible_network_os == 'arista.eos.eos'
```
